title: Credo (Lassus, Missa Susanne un jour)
desc: Orlande de Lassus, Missa Susanne un jour, Credo, 1570. 5 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Tenor Secundus, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0020_3); edited by Vincent Besson, Marco Gurrieri, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
